summary: No open table of echinoid larvae reared in calcium-free versus normal seawater was found. The nearest repository data are ocean-acidification larval experiments in PANGAEA (e.g. 907717 with 82,177 data points on mortality, abnormality and morphology; 942320 with 35,354 on development and growth) and a Dryad larval-calcification set; these alter carbonate saturation, not the presence of lime, and I did not open their column lists.
next_step: Open PANGAEA 907717/942320 to see whether arm length and skeletal-rod scores are columns; if the lime-free premise itself is to be tested, digitise the published lime-free rearings (Herbst-era and later papers) into a small table.
obstacles_confirmed: A dedicated open replication dataset of calcium-free rearing does not exist in the repositories searched.
Acidification experiments manipulate carbonate, not calcium or 'lime', so they are only a proxy for skeleton suppression.
